takeaways.title: Global Pressure Belts and Coriolis Deflection
takeaways.detail: Air moves from subtropical highs toward equatorial lows, deflected rightward in the Northern Hemisphere by Coriolis force, producing the northeast trade winds and mid-latitude westerlies.

takeaways.title: Saturation, Dew Point, and Adiabatic Cooling
takeaways.detail: Rising air parcels expand and cool at the dry adiabatic rate (10°C/km) until reaching dew point temperature (LCL), transitioning to the saturated rate (6°C/km) with latent heat release.

takeaways.title: Monsoons and Trans-Oceanic Merchant Networks
takeaways.detail: Seasonal reversal of Indian Ocean monsoon winds dictated sailing schedules, port-city autonomy, and cultural syncretism across maritime Southeast Asia, India, and East Africa without centralized naval hegemony.

takeaways.title: Urban Form, Zoning, and Ecological Footprint
takeaways.detail: Suburban sprawl expands impervious surface runoff and automobile dependency; Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) and mixed-use density reduce per-capita emissions and land consumption.

takeaways.title: Spatial Queries, Vector Topology, and Attribute Selection
takeaways.detail: Combining boolean SQL attribute queries (WHERE elevation > 2000) with spatial topological operators (ST_Intersects, ST_Within) isolates target environmental features in GIS workflows.
